short: Keeps a hidden line to infected computers and sends them commands.
analogy: Has a radio link to an accomplice waiting outside.

solutionNotes.ndr: Spots “beacons,” tunnels and communication with the attacker’s server.
solutionNotes.ngfw: Blocks connections to known malicious addresses and unnecessary protocols.
solutionNotes.ti: Supplies fresh addresses and domains of command servers.
solutionNotes.ids: Recognizes known signatures of command channels.
solutionNotes.edr: Sees which program on a computer is connecting outward.
